question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

It’s ______ to see how the movie star acted in real life.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Disappointing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Disappointing"** means causing someone to feel sad or unhappy because something was not as good as expected; disheartening. (निराशाजनक)

 
 
• **Example: **The ending of the movie was disappointing because it left many questions unanswered.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that seeing how the movie star behaved in real life is disheartening. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to describe how the movie star acted in real life is **'Disappointing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Disappointing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disappointed **(निराश): Feeling sad or unhappy because something was not as good as expected.

 
 
• **Example:** She was disappointed when she didn't get the job.
 
 
 
• **has disappointed **(निराश किया है): Refers to someone or something that has caused disappointment.
 
 
• **Example: **The performance has disappointed many fans.
 
 
 
• **Disappoint **(निराश करना): To fail to meet the hopes or expectations of someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He didn't want to disappoint his coach by skipping practice.
